data.title: Director Nutrition & Scientific Affairs (EMEA)
data.description: About The Job At Danone we are committed to our mission of “bringing health, through food to as many people as possible”. Beyond this we are working together to make sure that our brands offer benefits for people, communities and the planet. If you join Danone, you will be part of one of the largest Certified B Corps™ in the world. Being B Corp means to be part of a select movement of companies verified to be meeting the highest standards of social and environmental criteria and using business as a force for good To successfully deliver against our mission and commitments, we are science driven and truly consumer centric, as nutrition & health is shaping our innovation and portfolio choices. Made possible by a number of experts in the business including our partners in Research & Innovation (R&I), who bridge the gap between science and food. This role is part of the Medical & Nutritional Science (M&NS) department, a global science-driven organization at the forefront of health and nutrition innovation, driving value creation and growth opportunities for Danone. To further strengthen our ambition within the EMEA region, we are looking for a senior leader who can drive the regional Nutrition & Scientific Affairs (NSA) agenda, connecting global scientific excellence with local market impact Core Objectives Contribute and implement Nutrition & Scientific Affair strategy for EMEA. Activate global science and evidence into region-wide strategic direction, ensuring coherent, high-impact execution that shapes category performance and competitive advantage. Main Responsibilities Strategy & Governance Contribute to the development and lead the execution of the EMEA NSA plan, ensuring alignment with global scientific pillars and Zone priorities. Science Activation Translate global science into regionally relevant Nutrition & Scientific Affair playbooks , including evidence-based narratives, claims guidance, scientific guardrails, and activation toolkits. Provide key strategic insights to shape Danone science agenda , leverage external relationship with KOL, Influencers etc External Scientific Engagement & Advocacy Represent EMEA NSA externally, engaging with health care professionals , KOLs, scientific societies, and expert communities to ensure credible and consistent scientific communication. Cross-Functional Integration & Portfolio Collaborate with the R&I VP EMEA and topline teams to ensure NSA input is integrated throughout relevant Innovation phases. Own the Health Danone Impact Journey delivery within the region, making sure the different stakeholders contribute in the delivery of the corporate health KPI. leverage the Danone health credential in internal and external relationships People Leadership & Operating Model Lead and develop the NSA Zone team (25 FTE), providing direction, coaching, and growth for scientific talent. About You We are looking for a proven leader in Nutrition & Scientific Affairs with experience gained in a comparably complex and multi layered, stakeholder led organisation such as Danone Leadership & Behaviours Strategic thinking and the ability to translate vision into action. Ability to influence senior stakeholders and operate credibly at zone level. Ability to lead through complexity, ambiguity, and change. Builds inclusive, empowered teams; develops talent; drives collaboration and accountability Innovation Skills & Competencies Understanding of the nutrition industry, ideally the EDP-based category. Capacity to interpret scientific research to serve FMCG products. Track record of engaging with external stakeholders to support business objectives. Education & Experience Education: Master in Health, Nutrition or Food Science (or comparable study). Progressive experience in the FMCG Foods business. Proven ability to engage senior business stakeholders, advocate for R&I, and influence strategic discussions. data.title: DDAI PRODUCT DIRECTOR
data.description: About The Job Danone France is not trying to be the best company in the world, but the best company for the world! That's why all 26 of our brands in France are B Corp™ certified. B Corp is the compass that guides our CSR strategy! This certification allows us to challenge ourselves, continually improve and measure our social and environmental performance. Danone's research and innovation (R&I) centre, located in Gif-sur-Yvette on the Saclay plateau, is a global center of excellence dedicated to food innovation research. Inaugurated in 2023, this ultra-modern center is at the heart of one of the world's leading scientific hubs. It is home to more than 500 passionate experts of 40 different nationalities, working in the fields of life sciences, health and nutrition, consumer experience and the development of tomorrow's products. Equipped with laboratories and pilot facilities, it supports innovation and development. The Danone R&I Center is part of a global research ecosystem designed to foster collaboration with food technology start-ups and accelerate innovation in partnership with consumers and food and health stakeholders. DDAI (Data, Digital & AI) is one of the strategic pillars of Danone’s global R&I transformation. It exists to accelerate how we innovate — by embedding digital, data and artificial intelligence into every step of our scientific, product, and operational workflows. DDAI enables R&I teams to deliver faster, better, and more confidently, turning complex science and insights into real business impact DDAI plays a pivotal role in: Accelerating innovation through digital twins, in‑silico models, advanced analytics, and GenAI tools. Strengthening scientific capabilities with proprietary AI models and integrated data ecosystems. Improving efficiency and compliance by digitizing QFS & R&I processes, enabling faster regulatory workflows. Upskilling the organization through the DDAI Academy and cross‑functional collaboration with IT&Data and QFS. DDAI is building the digital, data and AI backbone of Danone R&I. Joining DDAI means joining a purpose‑driven, pioneering team at the heart of how Danone reinvents health through food, reshaping how Danone designs the next generation of products, services, and scientific breakthroughs powered by science and technology. Position Overview : Reporting to the Senior Director of DDAI Programs, the DDAI Product Director will: Lead the development and delivery of key DDAI programs, co-build the mid-term (1-3 years) strategy Act as a strategic partner to senior business owners within R&I, building product roadmaps and driving their execution (strategy to action). Inspire and engage teams behind the vision while infusing domain knowledge and technical expertise. Key Responsibilities : Drive the execution of the strategy by focusing on building and executing detailed product roadmaps and project portfolio within our key R&I flagships. Business Impact & Superiority: Hold accountability for delivering measurable impact on business results. Demonstrate ownership on the product, acting as the guardian of product superiority. Serve as a key connector and business partner, able to lead, influence, and negotiate in a matrix organization. Deliver through others, including Product Owners and agile squad teams. Senior Engagement: Act as a key strategic partner to senior business owners and experts, managing and arbitrating conflicting requirements to translate needs into actionable strategies. Market & Trends: Understand R&I trends, market and consumer dynamics. Actively seek and exchange best practices by partnering with other CBUs/departments. Adaptation & Change: Lead change and transformation programs. Act fast, managing risk and building mitigation plans based on cross-functional experts' inputs. About You Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant technical, scientific, or business field. 10+ years of experience in digital data & AI product management, with a proven track record of bringing complex products to market. Deep domain expertise in a relevant field (e.g., life sciences, computational biology, AI/ML, digital health, consumer analytics) combined with a strong product vision. Proven expertise in Agile product management leadership, including experience with building roadmaps, feature prioritization, and managing product lifecycles. Demonstrated transverse leadership skills, with the ability to lead and influence cross-functional teams and product owners without direct managerial authority. Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with experience partnering effectively with senior business leaders to define product strategy. Experience working in a complex, matrixed organization, preferably within an R&I, CPG, or pharmaceutical environment. data.description: About The Job For over 100 years, Danone has been supporting people worldwide with its 146 delicious brands. Located in over 120 countries with more than 89,000 employees across production sites, warehouses, headquarters, and R&D centers, Danone continually develops iconic products. Certified as Bcorp and Happy Trainees, Danone strives to be a better company for the world, its consumers, and its employees. B Corp certified, Danone France does not seek to be the best company in the world, but better for the world! This certification allows us to challenge ourselves in order to continuously improve and measure our social and environmental performance. YOUR MISSIONS AT DANONE: We are seeking a motivated apprentice with a strong interest in digital transformation and process optimization to join our Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) team. This position offers hands-on exposure to a global IT transformation program focused on harmonizing business processes and deploying PLM solutions across multiple regions. You will work closely with IT Senor Product Owners and cross‑functional teams to support activities related to data management, process improvement, and system integration. You will own and drive your squad backlog, defining and managing epics and user stories, preparing refinement sessions, sprint planning, and maintaining Jira to ensure alignment across the team and efficient delivery. You will capture, clarify, and prioritize business needs with key stakeholders and translating them into clear functional requirements and acceptance criteria for the development team. You will support the definition, monitoring, and remediation of Data Quality (DQ) rules, working closely with cross-functional teams (IT, Business, and Data Factory). You will coordinate and support testing activities throughout the delivery lifecycle to secure quality of release. You will support Run Activities (BAU) following up on incidents and change requests in coordination with BSO and AMS Back‑Office support teams PLUS POINTS OF THIS JOB: Up to 2 days/week of remote work Full reimbursement of Navigo pass/TCL subscription "Vendredi je grandis" program: development every Friday afternoon covering career, soft skills, and hard skills. data.description: About The Job The Senior Scientist – Enzyme Technology drives the scientific discovery, characterization, and application of enzymes to support innovation across Danone product categories. The role includes leadership of a team composed of three scientists and one technician, and plays a central role in coordinating the internal Danone enzyme network as well as strategic relationships with external enzyme suppliers and partners. The role combines technical leadership, people management, project ownership, and ecosystem management (internal and external). Key Responsibilities 1. Scientific & Technical Leadership Guide the development of enzyme-based solutions to advance Danone's product development and innovation: Demonstrated experience applying enzymes within complex food matrices (e.g., dairy, plant-based systems) to deliver targeted product functionalities Strong understanding of enzyme–substrate interactions in heterogeneous and multi-component food environments Proven capability to translate enzymatic activity into measurable product outcomes, such as improved texture, flavor, stability, and overall product quality Evaluate new technologies and integrate them into R&D pipelines. Provide expert input on enzyme function and product–process interactions to product developers and other functions Collaborate with the analytical science team to identify tools and methodologies. 2. Project Management & Cross‑Functional Collaboration Act as technical lead or project lead in cross‑functional project teams including Fermentation, Downstream Processing, Analytics, Application Technology, Regulatory, and Product Management. Translate business needs into technical workstreams and ensure timely delivery of milestones. Contribute to portfolio strategy, capability building, and technology roadmaps. 3. Team Leadership & Talent Development Manage, mentor, and develop a team of scientists/technicians working in enzyme technology. 4. External Engagement & Innovation Scouting Act as a key point of contact for enzyme suppliers, fostering strategic, long-term technical partnerships. Collaborate with academic partners, CROs, technology providers, and ingredient or enzyme suppliers Scout emerging trends in enzyme technology Support patent strategy and preparation of IP filings, ensuring protection of innovations. About You Education PhD in Food Science and Technology, Enzymology, Biotechnology, or related field. Alternatively: MSc + substantial industry experience in enzyme technology. Experience 7+ years in enzyme R&D, industrial biotechnology, or related fields. Proven track record of leading scientific projects and developing enzyme products or technologies. Experience managing or mentoring scientists/technicians. Industry experience in food ingredients, industrial biotech, or enzyme suppliers is a strong advantage. Participer à la définition des axes stratégiques des achats lait. En particulier, le pilotage des volumes de lait conventionnel et biologique afin d’accompagner le développement de l’usine du Molay-Littry. Collaborer en proximité avec la marque Les 2 Vaches pour l’accompagner dans sa stratégie de développement et de mise en avant de notre filière lait biologique, équitable et normand. Coordonner et entretenir le lien entre l’usine du Molay-Littry la Direction Lait. Le poste est basé sur le site du Molay-Littry (3 jours/semaine minimum sur site). Cette certification permet de nous remettre en question afin de progresser continuellement et mesurer notre performance sociale et environnementale. Le CCR Distributeur circuit Away from home (hors domicile) pilote son activité en lien avec les priorités business de Danone sur l’ensemble des catégories (WATERS /PLANT BASED/DAIRY), et saisit toutes les opportunités pour développer le CA, les PDM et la rentabilité de son parc. Au sein de la direction commerciale, votre CVR vous accompagnera pour vous développer sur vos principales missions qui seront les suivantes et réparties en 3 pans : Business/Clients : Est le référent Danone des différents interlocuteurs décisionnaires des clients distributeurs (DG, Achats, Logistique, Télévente) Assure les visites chez les distributeurs BSA et UF-BV Négocie et pilote la présence de nos gammes et innovations en sell-in et en sell-out Négocie, anime et pilote les accords locaux en lien avec la stratégie de l’entreprise et avec les accords nationaux négociés par les KAM Met en place des actions spécifiques sur nos catégories pour se démarquer de la concurrence Assure la gestion des litiges Travaille le maillage avec les KOL de son secteur et garantie l’image de Danone auprès de ces derniers Participe à des salons avec offres spécifiques négociées et à des évènements clients Fait profiter de son expertise aux CM sur les négociations et la gestion d’un distributeur Pratique une veille concurrentielle active Pilotage/Reporting : Analyse mensuellement les sell-in /sell-out pour mise en place d’actions correctives versus Busines plan Sait piloter son P&L en phase avec les objectifs de l’entreprise Est garant des bonnes données financières et gestion des différents budgets Assure la bonne mise en œuvre de la stratégie nationale en lien avec les KAM Animation FDV : Met son expertise distributeur au service de l’équipe et est garant du partage et de la fluidité des informations Agit en chef d’orchestre et anime les CM pour assurer une présence permanente auprès des entrepôts de son parc Met en place des actions au service du maillage entre les forces de ventes distributeurs et la force de vente Danone (ex : commandos, after-works, formations...) Nos engagements employeur : La garantie d’un package de rémunération pertinent, compétitif et évolutif grâce à un benchmark externe et une équité interne. Il se compose entre autres d’un salaire fixe, d’un variable annuel, d’une prime d’intéressement et/ou participation et d’une action Danone. Le développement des compétences de chacun avec la Danone Academy France et un cycle de conversation managérial. La possibilité d’utiliser 3 jours par an de bénévolat via notre plateforme Vendredi. Des avantages pour la parentalité et les aidants avec la possibilité de convertir une partie de sa rémunération en temps. Notamment 14 jours de plus de congé maternité / paternité. D’autres avantages tels que la mutuelle, la retraite supplémentaire, le CSE, etc. A PROPOS DE VOUS Les critères ci-dessous restent indicatifs. Vous aimez la performance et avez envie de vous dépasser.
